sections.description:
[[File:EntitySprite armor-stand.png|16x16px|link=Armor Stand|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Armor Stand|Armor Stand]] and [[File:EntitySprite mannequin.png|16x16px|link=Mannequin|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Mannequin|Mannequin]] also count for this advancement.

sections.gameDescription: Kill five unique [[mob]]s with one [[crossbow]] shot
sections.reward: 85XP [[experience]]
sections.title: Arbalistic

sections.description: Sneak while causing a vibration within 8 blocks of a [[sculk sensor]] or 16 blocks of a [[warden]].
sections.gameDescription: Sneak near a Sculk Sensor or Warden to prevent it from detecting you
sections.title: Sneak 100

sections.description: Receive kill credit for a [[breeze]] killed by a breeze-shot [[wind charge]].
sections.gameDescription: Kill a [[Breeze]] with a deflected Breeze-shot [[Wind Charge]]
sections.reward: 40XP [[experience]]
sections.title: Blowback

sections.description: Use a [[brush]] on an armadillo.
sections.gameDescription: Get [[Armadillo Scute]]s from an [[Armadillo]] using a [[Brush]]
sections.title: Isn't It Scute?

sections.description: Be at least 30 blocks away horizontally when the center of a [[target]] is shot with a projectile by the player.
sections.gameDescription: Hit the bullseye of a Target block from at least 30 meters away
sections.reward: 50XP [[experience]]
sections.title: Bullseye

sections.gameDescription: Make a [[Decorated Pot]] out of 4 [[Pottery Sherd]]s
sections.title: Careful Restoration

sections.gameDescription: Be near a [[Crafter]] when it crafts a Crafter
sections.title: Crafters Crafting Crafters

sections.description: Fall from at least Y=319 to at most Y=-59 with a vertical distance of ''greater than'' 379 blocks. Jumping before the fall is not recommended as it tends to not award the advancement.
sections.gameDescription: Free fall from the top of the world (build limit) to the bottom of the world and survive
sections.title: Caves & Cliffs

sections.gameDescription: Place a [[Creaking Heart]] with the correct alignment between two [[Pale Oak Log]] blocks
sections.title: Heart Transplanter

* [[File:BiomeSprite basalt-deltas.png|16x16px|link=Basalt Deltas|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Basalt Deltas|Basalt Deltas]] * [[File:BiomeSprite crimson-forest.png|16x16px|link=Crimson Forest|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Crimson Forest|Crimson Forest]] * [[File:BiomeSprite nether-wastes.png|16x16px|link=Nether Wastes|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Nether Wastes|Nether Wastes]] * [[File:BiomeSprite soul-sand-valley.png|16x16px|link=Soul Sand Valley|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Soul Sand Valley|Soul Sand Valley]] * [[File:BiomeSprite warped-forest.png|16x16px|link=Warped Forest|alt=|class=pixel-image|]][[Warped Forest|Warped Forest]]
The advancement is only for Nether biomes. Other biomes may also be visited, but are ignored for this advancement.
sections.gameDescription: Explore all Nether biomes
sections.reward: 500XP [[experience]]
sections.title: Hot Tourist Destinations
